# Global Definition Of Done

A deliverable is complete only when all dimensions pass:

1. Functional
2. Localized
3. Responsive
4. Validated
5. Authorized
6. Tested
7. Observable
8. Documented

## Mandatory pass criteria

- Meets assigned PRD requirements with no contradiction.
- Uses required architecture and security patterns.
- Includes complete UX states and accessibility expectations.
- Includes appropriate automated/manual verification evidence.
- Introduces no major regressions.

## Failure handling

If any DoD dimension fails:
- phase remains open
- blockers are documented
- no phase transition permitted
